persona: Woman trying Strata for the first time after hearing about it on TikTok

B01.reason: Remove repetition while keeping the short control meaning and clear configuration state.

B02.reason: Conversation length is understandable first; labelled Automatic or Custom keeps batch discoverable without demanding adjustment.

B03.reason: Fit and memory answer the immediate setup question; speed samples belong in an explicit optional section.

B04.reason: One primary save action and an explicit available apply action clarify what happens next; secondary tools remain reachable.

B05.reason: Expert is a deliberate working view where recommendations and application scope help recovery; effects can be disclosed.

B06.reason: One selected recommendation follows a straightforward choice without comparing duplicate cards or decoding shared-winner chips.

B07.reason: The exact selected download must stay identifiable even when technical explanation is optional.

B08.reason: Fit, memory and download cost are useful first-chat decisions; optional speed does not need to dominate ordinary cards.

B09.reason: A compact actionable no-fit state and one action for a shared winner prevent apparent dead ends and duplicate downloads.

B10.reason: Show what is already usable, keep Discover visible and respect a deliberate tab choice.

B11.reason: Aligned facts make an optional deliberate comparison easier than three repeated instrumentation panels.

B12.reason: A required download and configuration review can contain optional tuning without making tuning a separate mandatory step.

B13.reason: Everyday work and Faster answers communicate the choice immediately; technical profile names remain available.

B14.reason: Compact detection and one exact recommendation let a first-time visitor review fit and download amount before commitment.

B15.reason: A real stage and specific recovery action explain waiting and failures; cancellation restart consequences must be visible.

B16.reason: Ready should lead directly to first chat with honest load or Demo status and optional technical depth.

B17.reason: Known lifecycle consequences matter when work exists; concise scope and real blockers prevent disruptive surprises.

B18.reason: One correctly scoped source label reduces repetition without losing evidence honesty or mixed-source distinctions.

B19.reason: A short actual review status prevents a starting recommendation being read as established capability.

B20.reason: Text-sample names distinguish speed testing from document support while preserving exact limits.

amendments: Under B03 and B08, the Speed details trigger should expose a concise unavailable or illustrative status so discovery never implies a real benchmark. Any displayed demo numbers keep a local Demo label.

Under B06 SELECTOR, show a shared-winner note inside the selected recommendation and a direct Try Everyday work recovery for a no-fit tools profile. Choosing a profile does not start a download or load.

Under B12 OPTIONAL, keep an explicit download and configuration review visible before Prepare; optional tuning auto-opens for invalid retained values. Preserve completed choices and resume mapping when changing the step count.
Under B13, Faster answers states the ranking priority, not a promised measured speed; keep relevant capability and Provisional warnings visible.
Under B17, use operational counts only when reliable and relevant. A genuinely empty first setup needs no extra lifecycle confirmation, and unknown counts must never become zero.
Under B19, use actual review metadata in one short line; avoid listing hypothetical untested tasks or introducing a new capability score.
Retain current font sizes, focus handling, keyboard alternatives and errors. These votes are simulated design judgments, not evidence of real-user success.
